description: §18.0.1 (amended S479) — a block `<match>` that omits `for=` over an `on=` of a known non-enum type (`int`) is E-TYPE-024: a match is over an enum, and `for=` stays required.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — S478 hand-off §3.A and §3.B, PA recs adopted" item 4
rationale: §18.0.1: "A `<match>` that omits `for=` where it stays required SHALL be: **`E-TYPE-024`** when the type of `on=` is known and is not an enum".
